GlobalPolicy.belief-state: BELIEF: hypothesis ACTUAL: observed STATUS: MATCH | MISMATCH (at PDD §6.x state-machine transitions)
GlobalPolicy.module-level-focus: Fast deterministic checks scoped to one module.
GlobalPolicy.wave-level-focus: Merged surfaces for the current feature batch.
GlobalPolicy.phase-level-focus: Full backend pytest plus both frontend vitest suites.
GlobalPolicy.autonomy-gate: Each module needs commands, scenarios, log markers, and wave/phase follow-up before long autonomous execution.
GlobalPolicy.ldd-hard-gate: Implementation/fix packets that touch state transitions, transaction boundaries, auth/role checks, OTP/SMS, payment webhooks, PII/secrets/logging paths, or required marker emitters MUST add or run LDD assertions. Final reports MUST list asserted markers or explicitly justify why LDD was not applicable.
GlobalPolicy.redaction: Never log JWT, OTP code, password hash, payment full PAN, raw webhook body. PII (phone, name, address) redacted by default per INV-013.
GlobalPolicy.redaction-assertion-gate: Packets touching auth/SMS/PII/logging MUST assert captured logs contain no raw phone, OTP code, JWT, password, full PAN, API key, raw webhook body, or full address.

VF-001.NAME: OrderHappyPath
VF-001.scenario: Customer places order, pays via YuKassa webhook, order moves to PAID, SMS confirmation sent.
VF-001.expected-outcome: Order in PAID; Payment in SUCCEEDED; sms_worker.send invoked once; INV-004 atomicity preserved.

required-signals.trace-sequence: BLOCK_TX_BEGIN -> BLOCK_STATE_TRANSITION(CREATED) -> BLOCK_TX_COMMIT -> BLOCK_WEBHOOK_VERIFY -> BLOCK_TX_PAYMENT -> BLOCK_STATE_TRANSITION(PAID)

VF-002.NAME: OtpLoginHappyPath
VF-002.scenario: Customer requests OTP, receives code, verifies, JWT issued, User ACTIVE.
VF-002.expected-outcome: OtpCode VERIFIED; User ACTIVE; JWT issued; PII (phone) not in logs.

VF-003.NAME: DeliveryHappyPath
VF-003.scenario: Order PAID -> PREPARING -> READY -> IN_DELIVERY -> COMPLETED with courier assigned.
VF-003.expected-outcome: All transitions logged with belief-state pairs at each PDD §6.1 / §6.3 boundary; INV-016 holds.

scenarios.scenario-1: All enum values match PDD §6 state-machine definitions.

V-M-SHARED.wave-follow-up: Validate that downstream modules import shared.grace.logging without circular dependency.
V-M-SHARED.phase-follow-up: Run full backend pytest to confirm enum stability.

module-checks.check-1: docker compose exec core-api alembic check
module-checks.check-2: docker compose exec core-api alembic upgrade head

scenarios.scenario-1: All migrations apply cleanly to a fresh test DB.
scenarios.scenario-3: Menu media migration adds presentational media fields without changing order_items, orders, payments, loyalty, or delivery tables.
scenarios.scenario-4: Menu inventory migration adds nullable inventory_quantity with a non-negative check and does not mutate order_items rows (INV-014).
scenarios.scenario-5: Database rejects direct UPDATE/DELETE on order_items and prevents order deletion from cascading into immutable item snapshots (INV-014).

V-M-DATABASE.wave-follow-up: Re-run migrations on a snapshot of prod schema before merging schema changes.

module-checks.check-1: docker compose exec core-api pytest services/core-api/tests/ -v
module-checks.check-2: docker compose exec core-api ruff check services/core-api/src

scenarios.scenario-1: Each routed mutation enforces INV-002 (returns 401/403 for unauth/wrong role).
scenarios.scenario-2: Each atomic flow (payment + points + promo) preserves INV-004 — full rollback on any failure.
scenarios.scenario-4: No code path bypasses PDD §6.x explicit transitions (INV-016).
scenarios.scenario-5: Public menu response exposes media_type/media_url/media_poster_url with legacy image_url fallback and no secrets or signed storage credentials (INV-015).
scenarios.scenario-6: Checkout enforces finite menu inventory with row locking and atomic decrement inside orders.create; insufficient inventory emits no commit.
scenarios.scenario-7: Staff order detail exposes customer contact phone only to ADMIN/BARISTA, keeps customer/courier routes blocked, and emits no raw phone in captured logs.
scenarios.scenario-8: Staff login throttles repeated invalid credentials by login and source IP, emits BLOCK_AUTH_VERIFY, and logs no password/JWT/refresh token.
scenarios.scenario-9: Core API refuses placeholder, short, malformed, or all-zero JWT_SECRET_KEY and ENCRYPTION_KEY outside explicit AURA_ENV=dev, without echoing raw secret values.
scenarios.scenario-10: Customer/admin account deletion drives ACTIVE/BLOCKED to DELETED, revokes sessions, cancels cancellable active orders, zeroes loyalty, removes profile/address PII, and preserves historical order FKs through an in-place tombstone.
scenarios.scenario-11: When shop_settings.ordering_paused=true, checkout estimate/order creation return a controlled pause response before order/payment writes, finite-inventory decrement, or BLOCK_TX_COMMIT.

required-trace-assertions.assertion-1: Failed atomic flow must NOT emit BLOCK_TX_COMMIT after a BLOCK_STATE_TRANSITION.
required-trace-assertions.assertion-2: Webhook handler must emit BLOCK_WEBHOOK_VERIFY before any DB write.

V-M-CORE-API.wave-follow-up: Run smoke pytest on touched routers plus dependent services.
V-M-CORE-API.phase-follow-up: Full backend pytest plus frontend vitest end-to-end.

module-checks.check-1: docker compose exec payment-worker pytest services/payment-worker/tests/ -v

scenarios.scenario-1: YuKassa webhook with a valid signature, when signature verification is configured, transitions Payment to SUCCEEDED.
scenarios.scenario-2: Invalid or missing signature webhook, when signature verification is configured, is rejected without JSON parsing or DB writes.
scenarios.scenario-3: Admin refund retry creates a new refunds row and drives REFUND_FAILED to REFUND_PENDING only after YuKassa accepts the retry.
scenarios.scenario-4: Nginx routes the public /api/webhooks/yukassa path to payment-webhook and overwrites client-supplied forwarded IP headers.
scenarios.scenario-5: Payment webhook handlers reject forbidden source states and duplicate terminal events without mutating payment/order/refund rows or emitting a state-transition marker.

module-checks.check-1: docker compose exec sms-worker pytest services/sms-worker/tests/ -v

scenarios.scenario-1: send_otp dispatches to SMS.ru and returns provider message_id.
scenarios.scenario-2: Rate-limited or provider 5xx falls back to retry per Celery policy without raising past max attempts.

scenarios.scenario-1: Cart state persists across page refresh.
scenarios.scenario-2: Checkout flow handles 4xx/5xx from core-api with retry UI.
scenarios.scenario-3: Menu media renders video when available and falls back to poster/image for reduced-motion, failed loads, or missing media.
scenarios.scenario-4: Media-led menu and item detail keep add-to-cart payloads unchanged: menu_item_id, size_option_id, modifier_ids, quantity.
scenarios.scenario-5: Customer menu/cart surfaces finite inventory caps and never lets UI increments exceed server-provided inventory_quantity.

scenarios.scenario-1: Role-gated routes redirect when JWT role mismatches.
scenarios.scenario-2: Orders feed updates within the 5-second staff expectation via websocket/poll without losing scroll position.
scenarios.scenario-3: Admin menu item form can create/update media_type/media_url/media_poster_url as public local static paths without binary upload handling.
scenarios.scenario-4: Admin/barista inventory controls edit menu_items.inventory_quantity with clear unlimited vs finite stock states; server remains the authorization gate.
scenarios.scenario-5: Order detail renders staff-only customer contact affordance from the staff detail payload without adding phone data to order lists.
scenarios.scenario-6: Staff API client stores access/refresh tokens, rotates the pair after a protected 401, retries once, and revokes the refresh token on logout before local cleanup.
scenarios.scenario-7: Admin/barista layout exposes role-filtered navigation on both desktop sidebar and mobile viewport surfaces; courier remains on CourierShell.
scenarios.scenario-8: Menu icon buttons expose localized accessible names, and courier tabs are wired to tab panels with aria-controls/aria-labelledby.

Gate-Local-Fast.goal: Pre-commit-ish local gate for lint, frontend typecheck, route/RBAC coverage, and an SMS LDD redaction smoke test against an already-running non-destructive Compose stack.

required-evidence.evidence-2: Both frontend lint and typecheck scripts pass.
required-evidence.evidence-3: Core API route/RBAC coverage tests pass.
required-evidence.evidence-4: SMS worker LDD marker/redaction smoke test passes.

Gate-Local-Full.goal: Full local verification against an already-running Compose stack: migrations, backend ruff, Python pytest suites, frontend lint/typecheck/Vitest/npm audit, browser smoke, and mandatory dependency audit gates. Browser smoke resets rows owned by known Phase 4 QA seed identifiers/users.

required-evidence.evidence-1: Alembic check and upgrade head pass in the core-api container.
required-evidence.evidence-2: Shared, core-api, payment-worker, and sms-worker pytest suites pass.
required-evidence.evidence-3: Both frontend lint, typecheck, Vitest, and npm audit gates pass.
required-evidence.evidence-4: Host-side pip-audit via uvx passes for core-api, payment-worker, sms-worker, and shared packages.
required-evidence.evidence-5: Core API, payment-webhook, nginx canonical /health, and Celery workers pass non-destructive readiness checks.
required-evidence.evidence-6: Playwright browser smoke passes for customer pickup checkout, admin logout to barista role switching, barista pickup transitions, and courier take/pickup/deliver flow.

Gate-Phase-Migration.goal: GRACE substrate adopted across all 7 modules; dev-workflow-kb retired; full backend + frontend test suites still green.

required-evidence.evidence-1: All Python public APIs have function contracts (CP3).
required-evidence.evidence-2: All TS exports have JSDoc contracts (CP4).
required-evidence.evidence-4: Existing test suites green; new LDD fixtures available (CP6).
required-evidence.evidence-5: AGENTS / CLAUDE / README updated; grace-refresh shows artifacts in sync (CP7).
